validation.execution: Apple Clang SDK27.2 Release WFS_FSKIT=ON; disposable source without Git metadata, deny-default sandbox denies home/keychain/publishing paths, loopback-only test transport. Signed FSKit module installed separately; owned disposable native repository.
validation.coverage: LevelDB and legacy flat namespace: strict EOF append, append handle and positioned handle, changed-prefix/gap writeback rejection, identical prefix retries, metadata, xattrs, parent entries, whole-file replacement, mixed flags, duplicated/orphan handles, chunked content, revision isolation and GC. Raw binary inode RPC and both FSKit callback transports included.

limits: Matching daemon/module binaries required: positioned-append open flag and fs-hwriteback are new RPC surface. Previous daemons reject the added FFINOD04 flag bit, including retained revisions. No on-disk layout change.

FSKit cached page writeback may include old bytes. Only the separate writeback API accepts identical overlap, checked before staging changes; ordinary handle/path writes remain EOF-only for append-only inodes.
Xattrs remain editable as measured on APFS. Owner can clear user flags; administrative root restore can select older revisions. No WORM or multi-user authorization guarantee.
Qualification is the listed private single-user macOS27.2.1 operations. No append-only mmap, arbitrary concurrent append/writeback load, power-loss or system append-flag guarantee.
